subject: Fenster Leads to Chase – 29 July 2026
body:
Adam,

The following quoted leads require action today:

E T & S Construction – St Mary's Refurbishment, Merthyr Tydfil
Owner: Adam
Current stage: gone quiet
Last contact: Overtaken by the re-issued register - the call is today and it is a question about the package being open, not a follow-up.
Next action: This is the urgent one and it is not a normal chase. The 24/07 re-issued register moved the package return date to 27 July - yesterday - on a package we submitted on 17 July and have treated as closed ever since. Adam asks Tom Godfrey one question outright: is the package still open, and is our 17/07 submission the one being considered. If it is open, this stops being a chase and becomes a corrected tender, and it goes straight back to Mary.
Deadline: 29 July 2026 (today)
Quote value: GBP 174,546

Ermine Construction Services – Ninn Lane Re-development
Owner: Adam
Current stage: gone quiet
Last contact: Nineteen days out with nothing back. Step 8 is overdue, not pending.
Next action: Adam calls Tom Dixon. GBP 100,730 has been out 19 days with nothing back, and Ermine also has Lower Range Road sitting with us unpriced against a 07/08 return. One call covers both: where is Ninn Lane, and do they still want Lower Range Road priced.
Deadline: 29 July 2026 (today)
Quote value: GBP 100,730

Chigwell (London) PLC – Leys Sports Pavilion Refurbishment (Leys Park Changing Pavilion, Dagenham)
Owner: Adam
Current stage: quoted
Last contact: Nine days out and two unanswered chases behind it. Step 8 is overdue, not pending, and it has been tried twice by email - this one is the phone.
Next action: Adam calls Luke Baker today, and it is a call - not a fourth email. Mobile 07547 184089, office 020 8500 4100. Our GBP 44,035.22 left estimating@ at 15:50 on 20 July and Adam has already chased it twice, 22/07 and 23/07, with nothing back either time - so 'did you get it' is a question that has failed twice already. Ask the one thing we do not have: Chigwell's bid to the London Borough of Barking and Dagenham closes today, so when does the council decide? That date is the next chase date. Gordon Court is the same call. And say nothing about a Grange Hill number - Gintare's quote is with Adam for checking and there is no settled figure to give.
Deadline: 29 July 2026 (today)
Quote value: GBP 44,035


134 AdminBase rows carry a follow-up date the CRM set that has already passed. They are not listed here because the date on them was not set by a person. They are on the Leads page, and any one of them appears in this email the day somebody puts a date on it.
